en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a formal procession or gathering of men in dark coats and uniforms, many wearing peaked caps, in front of a large neoclassical building with tall columns and sculptural relief above the entablature. The scene appears ceremonial, with people assembled in rows on a cobblestone square, trees without leaves in the background, suggesting a cool season.
